'''Shainrahien''' was a city in [[Safer]], which was part of the [[Ten Nations]]. Other than the name, little is known about it. {{ref|{{bwb}}, Ch10|Ch10}}

Its name translated into the Common Tongue is possibly "Dawn of Peace" - from the [[Old Tongue]] words ''shain'' (meaning "peace") and ''rahien'' (meaning "dawn"). {{ref|{{twotc}}, Old Tongue Dictionary}}
